# Talon Production House

> A video and photo production house and rentable studio space in Bengaluru, India. Shoots commercial films, brand campaigns, music videos, documentaries, and portrait/product stills.

Talon is a boutique production company with a small in-house crew handling direction, cinematography, and post-production. The studio floor in J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru is available for hourly, half-day, and full-day rental with lighting and grip equipment included.

## Work

- [Motion](https://talonproductionhouse.com/work/motion): Commercial films, music videos, documentaries, and brand films
- [Stills](https://talonproductionhouse.com/work/stills): Portrait and product photography series

## Company

- [Studio](https://talonproductionhouse.com/studio): Studio rental space, specs, equipment, and WhatsApp booking
- [The Team](https://talonproductionhouse.com/team): Founder and leadership bios
- [Contact](https://talonproductionhouse.com/contact): Instagram, YouTube, phone, email, and WhatsApp
